Opposition Parties Write to CJI Over Voter Verification Drive

Twenty-three opposition parties have written to the Chief Justice of India (CJI) regarding the voter verification drive (SIR) in Karnataka. The parties have accused the Election Commission of bias and alleged electoral malpractices under the current government, seeking a halt to the drive and an inquiry. Some reports also mention allegations of irregularities by NDA leaders.
